images.prompt: EDIT TARGET: attached exact original capital ship sprite. Make ONE whole-ship DAMAGE STATE for an 8-bit pixel-art space game, state 1 of 3 in damage pattern 1. This is a complete sprite, not a sheet. Exact same top-down camera, bow UP, proportions, hull silhouette, slate gray-blue armor, central spine, triangular bridge and three cyan engine layout as the reference. No redesign, no rotation, no additional ships. Build tangible hand-authored-looking damage at ONLY these locations: a medium torn armor breach on left outer deck, 43 percent down the ship; a larger torn plate on right outer flank, 64 percent down. Each breach must have visible bent metal, jagged torn plate lips, severed girders, exposed pipes and dark layered interior machinery, with subtle warm orange embers. Vary the sizes organically. DO NOT simply erase transparent circles/polygons, DO NOT make clean cutout holes with no structure. Interior damage areas mostly dark opaque exposed machinery, preserving the mass of the vessel. Keep all other parts precisely intact. Especially the engine damage, if listed, is SMALL and never blows away the engine bank. No explosion clouds or detached debris baked in; these are animated by code. Crisp stepped pixel edges, limited colors consistent with the reference; no blur. Transparent space outside the single entire ship. No text, no stars, no scene, no border.
